name: Stretched Second
description: Stretch a second to twice its length round the forearm so a blow can be turned in the extra span.

name: Mired Foot
description: Slow the time in an opponent's foot so it sticks to the floor between one step and the next.

name: Drawn Out
description: Draw out the time of a single punch in an opponent's arm until it takes a whole breath to land.

name: Slow Salve
description: Ease an ally's burn by slowing time in the wound until the nerves stop firing.

name: Syrup Air
description: Thicken time in the air before the user so that all who move through it are slowed.

name: Stalled Blow
description: Slow a blow's time as it arrives so it stalls inches from the body and loses its force.

name: Venom Wane
description: Age a poison inside an ally until it breaks down and loses its sting.

name: Stalled Moment
description: Hold one opponent in a single stretched moment so that the world moves on without them for a few breaths.

name: Lingering Weight
description: Strike so the harm is slow to land and grows heavier at each heartbeat after.

name: Pace Sense
description: Spread a faint field round the user in which the pace of any moving thing can be read.

name: Slow Drag
description: Let the field's edge run slow so that an opponent who steps in begins to drag.

name: Fast Core
description: Run time faster at the centre of the field so the user's thought and body stay ahead of the edge.

name: Second Knock
description: Strike anything that enters the field with the force of a second compressed into one touch.

name: Rim Delay
description: Slow the field's rim so that arriving blows lose their force at the edge.

name: Quick Surge
description: Run an ally's time faster inside the field so their movements gain a step.

name: Pace Snare
description: Close the field on an opponent so their time slows to a crawl while they stay inside it.

name: Quickened Wound
description: Run time faster in an ally's wounds inside the field so they close during the fight.

name: Layered Pace
description: Set several fields of differing pace one inside another so foes at the rim crawl and foes at the centre are stopped.

name: Perceived Thread
description: Read the thread of near cause in the field and know the likely next three moves of every body in it.

name: Twin Pulse
description: Run a matched pulse of quickened time down both arms at once.

name: Paired Beat
description: Strike with both hands on two beats so that the second arrives in the echo of the first.

name: Reflected Tempo
description: Match an opponent's pace for one beat with the forearm and turn the blow aside on the beat.

name: Dual Tempo
description: Step with one foot in quick time and one in slow so the body turns past a strike.

name: Slow-Fast
description: Run one of an opponent's arms fast and the other slow so the body twists and loses its guard.

name: Tandem Mending
description: Run one pulse of quickened time through a wound and one of slowed time through its pain to mend the first and ease the second.

name: Paired Moment
description: Chain a quickened strike and a slowed counter in matched time so that the two land as one blow.

name: Twin Stall
description: Stall both of an opponent's arms in separate moments so that neither can answer the other.

name: Hawk Instant
description: Stoop on a target in the single instant a hawk takes to see its prey.

name: Keen Moment
description: Stretch a moment so that the eye can pick one move from the many.

name: Wing Delay
description: Spread the arms and slow the time round them so a blow slides along the wings.

name: Plunge Pace
description: Fall on a quickened beat from a height to land beside the target.

name: Stoop Echo
description: Stoop once and echo the stoop a moment later on the same spot.

name: Hover Lag
description: Hang in the air a heartbeat longer than a body should so an opponent's blow passes below.

name: Sharp Mend
description: Quicken an ally's wound in a single sharp pulse to close it at once.

name: Azure Instant
description: Drive a thrust through one frozen instant of the guard as a hawk strikes between two blinks.

name: Blink Reach
description: Reach an opponent in the time of one blink and hold their time still long enough to strike.

name: Sworn Pace
description: Swear to keep a pace and let the oath hold the body to it.

name: Wind Beat
description: Strike on the beat of a rising gust.

name: Gust Lag
description: Drag a gust's time so its push comes late and throws the opponent off balance.

name: Draft Time
description: Feel how a draft ages the air in a room and learn when a person last passed.

name: Level Pace
description: Run a long open stride in even quickened time without a stagger.

name: Oath Delay
description: Hold an opponent's step in a sworn delay that ends when the word is lifted.

name: Pace Mend
description: Swear to see an ally to the end of the wound and quicken its mending on the breath.

name: Bearing Slow
description: Slow everything that crosses a held bearing between the user and the mark.

name: Gale Quicken
description: Run an ally's time forward on a hard wind so their pace gains a full step for the length of the gust.

name: Sworn Stall
description: Stall a charge in a sworn span of slowed time and take what weight remains on a ward.

name: Held Moment
description: Hold a single moment fast in an opponent's body so the next move cannot come.

name: Oath Beat
description: Speak the short oath on a beat and let it steady the user's time.

name: Moment Guard
description: Fix the guard in one moment so it neither tires nor shifts.

name: True Interval
description: Take the true interval between two sounds or two steps and learn the distance.

name: Vow Pause
description: Bind an opponent in a paused moment that holds until the vow is released.

name: Unbroken Mend
description: Hold the moment of a wound open and mend it before it passes into a scar.

name: Open Moment
description: Hold open the moment between a fallen ally's last breath and death to start the heart again within a short window.

name: Oath Stall
description: Stall the flow of qi in an opponent's body for as long as the oath holds.
